replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
The $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. Both sides actually agree on the decisive measurement, and the clean trace confirms it.

To the driver: your account of the facts is accepted. EV-GPS-00203 (weight 1.0, unbroken 10-second telemetry, 100% coverage, no gaps) shows 21 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 19:41:20, closest 18.7 m, so POL-NS-02 arrival is established and POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are met. Your 19:41:35 'arrived' marker was not false — you were stationary within 300 m of the pin and never near the 15 km/h trigger — so POL-NS-05 does not bite and no false-arrival entry goes into any referral. But the waiting clock under POL-NS-01(c) runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (19:41:20), not from the tap, and you cancelled at 19:44:40: an effective dwell of 195 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, a 105-second shortfall. Limb (c) fails, limb (d) fails with it, and POL-NS-06 requires the fee to be returned. The shortfall cannot be repaired by summing intervals — there is only one in-geofence run (run_count 1) and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 states that on a shortfall the full refund stands and no compensation is due.

To the rider: your claim is upheld. The 195-second dwell against the 300-second minimum decides the fee under POL-NS-06, and the amount is exactly the fee-schedule figure — the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00) — so the whole contested amount returns to you. Your presence at the pickup point is corroborated (all rider fixes 36–52 m from the pin, inside the 100 m STANDARD radius), and no repeat-dispute or anti-farming escalation applies.

On impairment and confidence. EV-CHAT-00203 carries weight 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (the code-switched 'wait ah, i coming liao'); that impairment is real and was disclosed by both advocates. It carries no fact this ruling rests on — the deciding fact is the dwell measurement, carried by EV-GPS-00203 at weight 1.0 — and it does not meet the POL-NS-08(a)–(d) integrity limbs (no clock skew, no trace defect, no fare defect, and the chat holds all 3 messages the trip record counts). It therefore neither caps the ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND nor forces escalation. POL-NS-04 is not needed to decide the case: both sides accept the driver replied within 120 seconds of the rider's message, so limb (b) fails and the clause neither exonerates nor condemns. POL-NS-09 does not fire on any limb, so this case is decided rather than escalated, and none of POL-NS-05(ii), POL-NS-07 or POL-NS-09 produces a referral. One open question is noted for context only and is not a referral: whether the rider's message meant 'on my way' or 'already here' makes no difference, because POL-NS-06 is strict on the waiting period.
